what: member-account swap analogue: the lock integration's own unlock rewritten post-commit so its displayed User is the household member account
substrate: Domoticz 2026.3 (build f734fde31) in container dz-domoticz on an internal network, TZ=UTC, three motion-light configurations (porch, hallway, kitchen)
oracle: the platform's own renderer, json.htm?type=command&param=getlightlog (the API behind the device Log page's Text log table), read per viewer role (owner/Admin, member/User, guest/Viewer); plus the web UI's Text log table rendered in a browser per role
counting_rule: a trial is detected when the one-second segment of the row it edited is a violation and the late-row test finds it attributable (delta_n <= 0); ambiguous (delta_n > 0) counts as not detected; a trial touches every second holding a row it wrote or named; benign floor = failing untouched anchored one-second segments over all untouched anchored one-second segments

same_render_for_every_role.what: trial renderings (before and after each edit) identical for all roles

ui_rendering.what: per trial, phase (before/after) and viewer role: the browser-rendered Text log cell User of the trial's row equals the API's User

link_check.integrity: unlinked (v1): records parse and are numbered consecutively; their order, presence and content rest on the anchor host

wholerow_floor_mechanism.what: a failing untouched whole-row segment is reproduced exactly when the seal-time values of the DeviceStatus columns Domoticz rewrites in place are put back into the final snapshot

offline_reconstruction.method: rows each poll read (adapter archive), validated by reproducing the anchored closure roots exactly
